hub.headline: Process · Test · Failure Analysis Engineering
hub.intro: 15+ years in HDD read/write head manufacturing at Western Digital. Each version below highlights the experience most relevant to that role.

profile.name: Peerapat Suwanphorung
profile.location: Klong Sam, Klong Luang, Pathum Thani 12120

variants.label: Senior Process Engineer
variants.headline: Senior Process Engineer
variants.summary: Engineer with 15+ years in precision electronics component manufacturing (HDD read/write heads) in cleanroom production, applying process qualification, DOE and reliability-testing methods that carry directly into EMS/PCBA process engineering. Evaluates new processes and engineering changes through qualification builds and testing, reporting clear recommendations to process owners and management. Experienced in build instructions, cycle-time reduction and technician supervision.

variants.label: Senior Test Engineer
variants.headline: Senior Test Engineer
variants.summary: Engineer with 15+ years in precision electronics component manufacturing (HDD read/write heads), including direct test-engineering experience planning DOE test execution and qualifying test equipment for new products. Evaluates new processes and engineering changes through qualification builds and reliability testing, feeding clear, data-driven recommendations to process owners and management.

variants.label: Process Engineer
variants.headline: Process Engineer
variants.summary: Engineer with 15+ years in high-tech electronics manufacturing (hard disk drive heads) in cleanroom production. Evaluates new processes and engineering changes through qualification builds and reliability testing, reporting clear recommendations to process owners and management. Experienced in build instructions, cycle-time reduction and technician supervision.

variants.label: Failure Analysis Engineer
variants.headline: Failure Analysis Engineer
variants.summary: Computer Engineering graduate with 15+ years in electronics manufacturing (hard disk drive heads), including hands-on failure analysis of reliability-test failures and new-process builds. Traces root cause with electrical debug, SEM and stress-test data (HAST, NaCl), reports clear findings, and organizes technicians and lab priorities to meet turnaround.

variants.label: Process Validation & Quality
variants.headline: Senior Process Engineer | Process Validation & Quality Engineering
variants.summary: Engineering professional with 15+ years of experience in process validation, quality assurance, and project management within the hard disk drive manufacturing industry. Experienced in qualifying new manufacturing processes and driving root-cause investigations to resolution, with hands-on exposure to Design of Experiments (DOE) methodology during a prior test engineering tenure. Focused on driving continuous process improvements through data-driven decision-making.

description.core: Evaluates a split-lot process change against POR from BQST/SDET results (mean shift, box plots vs. spec limits, paired tracking) and gives a pass / caution / fail recommendation.
description.fa: Compares a split-lot process change against POR from BQST/SDET results; paired tracking flags units that pass one test stage but fail the next.
